_metric.strict: score_vuln > score_patched; ties count as losses
_metric.tie_definition: exact float equality of the model score
_metric.ci: 2.5/97.5 percentile bootstrap over pairs, 10,000 resamples, resampling unit = pair

config.nograph_arm: same trained pipeline with edge_index and edge_type emptied, so only the graph is removed
config.slice_threshold: Jaccard 0.95 on node text and on edges

env.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
